Guillotine costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: Eyes on me, you fools!
I am Guillotine de Mephisto, the Guardian of Balance.
I'm about to cut loose, think you can handle it?

You are my assistant, therefore you must obey me.
I will protect you, no matter what happens.

Once, I was trapped in the prison they call "loneliness".
But after being with you, I have freed myself from those fetters!

Whenever I see you, my heart starts to race.
Perhaps I need to see a doctor?

Calm down, One-Winged Dark Lord. 
Your powers are no use here.

The One-Winged Dark Lord does not stir in your presence.
It seems to have accepted you.
No one could ever understand me. I'm destined to be alone.
Those people look suspicious. Are they from the Big O?
If you want to hide from the Big O, there's no better place than the Church. They wouldn't dream of stepping foot in there.
Aren't you curious about what I've got here in my right eye?
Heh heh. I can feel the power surging through my body.
Hold up...I've got a pang in my eye.
Great, now the Big O will really have it out for me.
Wait, is this... what I've been looking for all this time?
What is this, some kind of bribe? Well... a smart move I suppose.
I know, I know... You don't have to thank me.
You may be the only person who understands me... My solitude...

It feels like the darkness inside me has been dispelled.
You haven't cast any spells on me, have you?
I've decided to show you who I am. All of me.
You want me over there? That could be arranged.
What is it?
I've got a bad feeling about this!
Let's get down to business.
Heh heh... You won't like me when I get angry.
This won't end well for you.
Let's have some fun, shall we?
Gotta reload.
Wait a second.
Careful.
Now!
Super, Ultra, Wyrmblast!
Ultra super-duper combo attack!!
Ain't nothing to it.
Too bad, so sad!
What a bunch of clowns.
Errggh!
Tsk!
Yeeoowch!
Urgh... Guess we'll have to settle this another time.
Score another one for the good guys. Hope the Big O doesn't get wind of it.
